lede: Wat Saen Mueang Ma accounts for 24 catalogued manuscripts, 13 of them flagged research-priority. It clusters in Phayao (100% of the corpus for this temple). Nearly all (83%) are written in Tham Lanna · อักษรธรรมล้านนา script. By support it leans to mulberry paper (saa) · กระดาษสา (75%) over palm-leaf · ใบลาน (25%). Dated witnesses run 1923–1975 CE (4 of 24 carry a date).
